name: Stylus profilometer
purpose: Measure step heights and surface profiles.
geometryBrief: Hinged hood, stylus arm, stage, sample and monitor.
behaviorBrief: Convolve true surface with stylus tip; generate height trace and scan settings.
inputs: Surface height field, stylus geometry, trace coordinates and vertical calibration ID
outputs: Height-versus-distance trace with step estimate and uncertainty
acceptance: Scan a certified step with plateaus wider than the tip. Evaluate height on the plateaus and compare with the certified interval; repeat in the reverse direction.

name: Optical profilometer
geometryBrief: Objective turret, motorized stage, interferometric optics housing and computer.
behaviorBrief: Height map, missing-data mask and optical roughness limits.
inputs: Reflecting surface and validity mask, vertical scan range and objective calibration
outputs: Areal height map, missing-pixel mask and roughness statistics
acceptance: Image a tilted flat with one prescribed signal dropout. Recover the input tilt and flag the missing region; the roughness calculation must exclude invalid pixels.

name: Atomic force microscope
geometryBrief: Isolation enclosure, scanner head, cantilever, sample holder and display.
behaviorBrief: Simulate tip convolution and scan path; separate measured from ideal topography.
inputs: Sample topography, specified tip geometry, XY raster and calibration
outputs: Apparent height image and roughness metrics with tip and sample provenance
acceptance: Image a narrow isolated ridge using two spherical probe radii with ideal tracking. The broader probe widens its apparent base while preserving peak height above the flat background.

name: Spectroscopic ellipsometer
purpose: Estimate thin-film thickness and optical constants.
geometryBrief: Source and detector arms, sample stage and goniometer controls.
behaviorBrief: Fit multilayer optical response with model assumptions and parameter uncertainty.
inputs: Wavelength array, incidence angles, layered optical model and measured or synthetic polarization spectra
outputs: Fitted thickness, assumed optical constants, residuals and ambiguity indicators
acceptance: Fit a reference film of independently known thickness using fixed optical constants. Compare thickness to its reference interval and inspect residuals across the measured wavelength range.

name: Reflectometer
geometryBrief: Microscope optics, sample stage, fiber link and spectrometer box.
behaviorBrief: Generate reflectance spectrum from stack and fit thickness.
inputs: Substrate/film optical constants, wavelength grid, illumination geometry and reference spectrum
outputs: Reflectance spectrum and fitted thickness with residuals
acceptance: In a lossless normal-incidence fixture, reduce film thickness to zero. Predicted reflectance must equal the bare-substrate Fresnel result across the grid.

name: Four-point probe
model: CDE ResMap 178 · manual load, Jandel 1 mm inline cartridge
purpose: Measure sheet resistance of conductive films.
geometryBrief: Probe head, four tips, stage, readout and cable.
behaviorBrief: Compute sheet resistance from geometry and conductivity; note edge corrections.
inputs: Conducting film map, calibrated four-tip geometry, drive current and voltage reading
outputs: Sheet resistance map in Ω/square with geometry correction and calibration ID
acceptance: Use an ideal infinite thin sheet with equally spaced collinear probes. Compare inferred sheet resistance to (π/ln 2) × V/I; reversing current reverses voltage and preserves resistance.
geometryStatus: Reference-anchored metric GLB; inferred rear and travel
simulationStatus: Infinite and NBS circular sheet corrections; reversal and maps
integrationStatus: Interactive result export and voltage-map import; headset not tested

name: Probe station
geometryBrief: Chuck, microscope, probe arms, enclosure and micrometer drives.
behaviorBrief: Position probes onto contacts; measure continuity, leakage and I-V curves.
inputs: Contact map and netlist, probe-tip poses and stimulus from a connected source meter
outputs: Contact pairing, continuity state and electrical readings with die coordinates
acceptance: Probe the ends of a known resistor then lift one probe. The connected sweep must recover its resistance; the second sweep must report an open contact.

name: Contact angle goniometer
purpose: Assess surface wetting and related treatment changes.
geometryBrief: Droplet dispenser, sample stage, camera and backlight.
behaviorBrief: Synthetic droplet fit and contact-angle uncertainty; no automatic biocompatibility inference.
inputs: Droplet side-view image, baseline, pixel calibration and fit model
outputs: Left and right contact-angle estimates with fit quality and image provenance
acceptance: Fit a noiseless semicircle resting on its diameter. Both edge angles should be 90° within the predeclared image-sampling tolerance.

name: X-ray photoelectron spectrometer
geometryBrief: Vacuum chamber, transfer arm, analyzer housing, rack and monitor.
behaviorBrief: Show reference spectra, peak fitting and composition estimates; not invented elemental results.
inputs: Referenced spectrum versus binding energy, energy calibration and sensitivity factors
outputs: Fitted component areas and relative composition with explicit reference factors
acceptance: Feed two nonoverlapping synthetic peaks of equal integrated area with identical response factors and zero background. The inferred composition must divide equally between those two components.

name: Raman microscope
purpose: Characterize material structure and chemical signatures.
geometryBrief: Microscope, objective turret, laser enclosure, sample stage and spectrometer.
inputs: Reference Raman spectra, calibrated shift axis and XY sampling grid
outputs: Shift spectra and spatial component-intensity map
acceptance: Assign two reference spectra with distinct isolated peaks to alternating tiles. Integrated peak-window maps must reproduce the known tiles without swapping axes.

name: FTIR spectrometer
purpose: Identify polymer functional groups and degradation signatures.
geometryBrief: Instrument lid, ATR crystal, sample clamp and display.
inputs: Reference and sample intensity spectra, wavenumber axis and baseline model
outputs: Absorbance spectrum and reference-library match with preprocessing history
acceptance: Feed sample intensity equal to one tenth of the reference in a test band and equal elsewhere. Ideal absorbance must be one in the band and zero elsewhere.

name: X-ray diffractometer
purpose: Investigate crystalline phases of suitable materials.
geometryBrief: Goniometer, sample stage, X-ray enclosure and console.
behaviorBrief: Reference diffraction peaks and simulated broadening; not raw fabricated evidence.
inputs: Reference lattice spacings, incident wavelength, angular grid and line-broadening model
outputs: Intensity versus 2θ with fitted peak positions and candidate phase labels
acceptance: Use a single ideal first-order reflection of known spacing and wavelength. Recover the angle from Bragg's law; symmetric broadening should increase width without shifting the centroid.
